name: moh731V2023Moh729bProphylaxisEncounters
description: MOH 729B F-MAPS, Universal prophylaxis, step 1: one row per encounter at the locations in the period with a prophylaxis obs -- PCP prophylaxis history (1109), plan (1261) or drug started / changed to (1263) -- and the prophylaxis the client is on at it: the new drug (1263) when the plan starts (1256) or changes (1259) it, none when it stops (1260) or is none (1107), otherwise (continue or no plan) the history (1109).

join.joinCondition: o.encounter_id = e.encounter_id AND o.voided = 0 AND o.concept_id IN (1109, 1261, 1263)

expressionOptions.expression: CASE MAX(IF(o.concept_id = 1261, o.value_coded, NULL)) WHEN 1256 THEN 'Start' WHEN 1259 THEN 'Change' WHEN 1257 THEN 'Continue' WHEN 1260 THEN 'Stop' WHEN 1107 THEN 'None' END

CASE WHEN MAX(IF(o.concept_id = 1261, o.value_coded, NULL)) IN (1256, 1259) THEN MAX(IF(o.concept_id = 1263, o.value_coded, NULL)) WHEN MAX(IF(o.concept_id = 1261, o.value_coded, NULL)) IN (1260, 1107) THEN NULL ELSE MAX(IF(o.concept_id = 1109, o.value_coded, NULL)) END
